# Channel:pwmCenter

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.0</span></div>

Get / Set the pwm center value of the channel.

```lua
local center = channel:pwmCenter([center])
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `center` | number | optional |  |
